title: AI is making life easy.
author: LHLLParis
selftext: I made this game in 3 days last week using Claude 4.5, gemini 2.5 pro and nano banana for the art. Very soon triple AAA games at our finger tips. Because Godot MCP is not all that yet lmao.

comments.author: LHLLParis
comments.body: And for those interested in testing it out live. Join my group here: https://groups.google.com/g/wsg-tester-group

comments.author: icekiller333
comments.body: Congrats :) it's definitely a good feeling! Hope youre having a blast

replies.author: LHLLParis
replies.body: It's fun. Come join the testing group on Google bro. I need testers!!

comments.author: thirtyfiveoo
comments.body: looks really cool for a 3 day’s work. could you share some tips on how you use claude and gemini together? also for the coding part, do you have prior experience? my games always fall short on the programming part because I don’t really know how to debug. takes too much time for the models to get it going right

replies.author: LHLLParis
replies.body: I have Claude code in my vscode and use gemini CLI in cmd. Then I troubleshoot with either one the problems or ideas. Debugging takes time but they do do the work eventually
